{{Quote|Hm. Not sure who's out there, but it looks like we've got guests. Let's give 'em a warm welcome, lads. You see a stranger, stick an axe in him!|Bazba}}

'''Bazba''' (Japanese: {{hl|バズバ|Bazuba}} ''Bazba'') is a [[boss]] appearing in {{FE8}}. He is the titular leader of Bazba's Bandits, a brigand group terrorizing the Borgo region of [[Renais]] during the [[War of the Stones]].

=={{FE8}}==
===Role===
Bazba appears as the [[boss]] of [[The Bandits of Borgo|Chapter&nbsp;3]] of {{FE8}}. Though he first appears in [[The Protected|Chapter&nbsp;2]] instructing his subordinate, [[Bone]], to pillage the nearby villages while Renais's military has been thrown into chaos from [[Grado]]'s invasion.<ref>{{cite|One, two, three... Ha ha ha! I love a good war! With all those soldiers preoccupied, we're free to pillage as we please! Right, Bone{{nwh}}you're in charge. Grab everything that's not nailed down and bring it to the hideout.|Bazba to [[Bone]] in [[The Protected|Chapter&nbsp;2]]|The Sacred Stones}}</ref>

[[Eirika]] counters Bone's forces, rescues three villages and also protects [[Ross]] and [[Garcia]]. Eirika did not initially intend on pursuing Bazba himself until [[Colm|a thief]] steals her [[Lunar Brace|bracelet]] and [[Seth]] insists that they recover it.

Bazba is then directly encountered by Eirika's forces in his hideout in the Borgo mountain range. [[Colm]], the one who stole Eirika's bracelet, is also present in the hideout to rob the brigands. Bazba ends up killed during the battle.

==Personality==
Bazba is as remorseless as he is ruthless; he is even gleeful that [[Grado]]'s assault means that the local villages are ripe for attack. He has no qualms about ordering his men to kill any that intrude into his hideout.

==Quotes==
===Battle quote===
{{Quote|I'm the head of this bandit pack, the mighty Bazba! Hope you've enjoyed your life, 'cuz its about to end!|Bazba, in {{title|The Sacred Stones}}.}}

===Death quote===
